title: File-system audit
description: What is big, stray, doubled or unlisted in the repo and Servex's home. Proposals only; nothing was changed.

add.title: 📊 Tally: 16 findings, about 15 GB of it avoidable
add.text:
Nothing was changed. Every card is a proposal. Measured 2026-11-09 by script (file sizes read from disk, not guessed).

**Biggest first**
- 10.3 GB: `worktrees/_retired` (outside the repo)
- 2.4 GB: Servex logs that are never rotated or are dead
- 1.2 GB: `.worktree-logs/` in the repo
- 1.3 GB: `.git` (history; some of it is logs committed over and over)
- 0.9 GB: screenshots under `ai/sessions`

**By kind:** growth 7 · junk 4 · duplicates 3 · unindexed 2

**Safe to do first (revertible):** G1, G2, G3, J3, D1-D3, U1.
**Not revertible once done:** G4, G5, J1, J2. Those are ignored files that git cannot bring back.

One rule behind most of this: Servex is the single writer of its logs, so rotation belongs there once, not per log.

add.title: 🌱 G1: llama.jsonl is 813 MB and dead
add.text:
**What:** the log of a local llama server that was last written on 2026-10-17.
**Where:** `%LOCALAPPDATA%/lew42/servex/logs/llama.jsonl` (plus 4 small `llama-*.jsonl` probe logs, 1 MB).
**Size:** 813 MB. The single biggest file we have.
**Why it matters:** it is a third of Servex's log folder and nothing has written to it in 23 days.
**Proposed action:** compress it once (zip, expect under 80 MB) into `moved-aside/`, then remove the original.
**Revertible:** yes, if zipped first.

add.title: 🌱 G2: four main logs have never been rotated
add.text:
**What:** `monorepo.jsonl` 346 MB, `servex.jsonl` 259 MB, `whisper.jsonl` 187 MB (plus `whisper.err` 72 MB), `system.jsonl` 108 MB. All started on 2026-09-22/24 and only ever grow. `monorepo.err` and `.out` (111 MB) stopped on 09-24.
**Where:** `%LOCALAPPDATA%/lew42/servex/logs/`.
**Size:** about 1.0 GB now. `monorepo.jsonl` alone adds roughly 7 MB a day.
**Why it matters:** only `Servex/Crumbs.js` rotates anything. A tail or a search over a 350 MB line file is slow, and a backup of the folder is huge.
**Proposed action:** one rotation step in Servex's log writer: at midnight or 50 MB, rename to `name.YYYY-MM-DD.jsonl`, zip files older than 3 days, delete zips older than 30 days. The dead `.err/.out` get zipped now.
**Revertible:** yes (a code change plus zipped files). Send to the Servex mastermind.

add.title: 🌱 G3: 4,556 per-agent logs, 383 MB, none ever removed
add.text:
**What:** one `agent-<role>-<name>.jsonl` per agent ever spawned: minions 1,307, clarity 1,022, reviewers 921, task masterminds 355.
**Where:** `%LOCALAPPDATA%/lew42/servex/logs/agent-*.jsonl`.
**Size:** 383 MB in a folder with 4,650 entries (slow to list).
**Why it matters:** the finished agents' truth is already in their session records; this is a second copy of the chatter.
**Proposed action:** move logs older than 14 days into `logs/archive/YYYY-MM.zip` on a schedule. Check first that nothing reads an old agent log (`git grep "logs/agent-"`).
**Revertible:** yes, zipped.

add.title: 🌱 G4: .worktree-logs/ holds 1.2 GB in 1,449 files
add.text:
**What:** build, merge and test output from each worktree. Includes two 72 MB `.patch` files of near-identical size from one worktree (`qf-7`, 2026-10-25).
**Where:** `<repo>/.worktree-logs/` (gitignored).
**Size:** 1,237 MB.
**Why it matters:** the largest folder inside the repo. It slows every editor search that does not honour `.gitignore`, and a repo backup copies it.
**Proposed action:** delete files older than 14 days; keep the newest log per worktree name. Make `worktree-up` do this on each run.
**Revertible:** NO. Ignored files are not in git.

add.title: 🌱 G5: .merge-shots/ is 292 MB in 148 folders
add.text:
**What:** screenshots taken at each merge. One folder is 80 MB (`task_asks-to-tasks-…`); `qf-7` alone has six folders of 7.7 MB each, near copies.
**Where:** `<repo>/.merge-shots/` (gitignored).
**Why it matters:** the shots only prove the merge at the time; after the merge the reviewer's copy lives in the task folder.
**Proposed action:** keep the newest folder per worktree name, delete the rest after 7 days. `merge.mjs` can prune as it writes.
**Revertible:** NO.

add.title: 🌱 G6: 866 MB of PNGs under ai/sessions
add.text:
**What:** 6,750 `.png` files inside session folders; only 611 PNGs in the whole repo are tracked, so about 6,000 are ignored copies (before/after shots, crawls, reshoots; `shots/before` alone is 21 MB).
**Where:** `public/framework/ai/sessions/2026/**` (96% of it dated Oct 2026). The biggest session folders: `10/13/session-730e8a7b` 193 MB, `10/20/session-e00f55c9` 151 MB, `10/12/session-cbdc3ef5` 77 MB.
**Why it matters:** `sessions/` is 1.5 GB, 87% of everything in `public/framework/ai`. Session folders are supposed to be small records.
**Proposed action:** at session close, a script zips a session's shots to one `shots.zip` in the same folder and leaves a link. Start with the three folders above.
**Revertible:** yes (zip first), but untracked originals are not in git.

add.title: 🌱 G7: git history grows from logs committed again and again
add.text:
**What:** `.git` is 1.3 GB (pack 1.16 GB). `ai/usage.jsonl` has been committed 1,260 times and `core/Test/results.jsonl` (6.7 MB, test output) 25 times, each commit storing a new copy.
**Where:** `public/framework/ai/usage.jsonl`, `public/framework/core/Test/results.jsonl`, and the other append logs in `git status` (33 modified files right now).
**Why it matters:** every landing adds a diff of the same growing files; clones and Cloudflare builds pay for it.
**Proposed action:** gitignore `core/Test/results.jsonl` (generated); commit `usage.jsonl` once a day, not on every landing. Related: the 166 MB `ai/index.jsonl` (333 lines of about 500 KB each) is ignored and rebuildable, so keep it out of git but rewrite it compactly instead of appending.
**Revertible:** yes (a `.gitignore` line).

add.title: 🧹 J1: worktrees/_retired is 10.3 GB
add.text:
**What:** 10 retired worktree folders (`orphans-2026-11-05`, `qf-1-2026-11-02-…`, `qf-2-2026-11-07-…` and others), moved aside by earlier cleanups.
**Where:** `C:/Code/lew42/worktrees/_retired/` (outside the repo).
**Size:** 10.3 GB. The single largest thing on the machine for this project.
**Why it matters:** disk space, and it slows any tool that scans `C:/Code/lew42`.
**Proposed action:** for each, check `git log` that its branch was merged (437 of 841 local branches are), then delete the folder. The oldest (Nov 2) first.
**Revertible:** NO for uncommitted work inside; yes for anything already committed to a branch.

add.title: 🧹 J2: stray worktree folder and 841 branches
add.text:
**What:** `C:/Code/lew42/worktrees/pid-gone-ends` (136 MB) has no `.git`, so git no longer knows it. 841 local branches exist; 437 are already merged into `compliance/dev`. Pool worktrees cost about 371 MB each (10 now), which is expected; `fold-2`, `item-verbs`, `updates-rework` are live work, so leave them.
**Where:** `C:/Code/lew42/worktrees/`, `git branch --merged compliance/dev`.
**Why it matters:** branch lists and tab-completion are unusable at 841.
**Proposed action:** move `pid-gone-ends` into `_retired`; delete the 437 merged branches in one scripted pass (dry run and manifest first).
**Revertible:** branches yes (reflog); the stray folder yes if moved, not deleted.

add.title: 🧹 J3: clutter at the repo root
add.text:
**What:** a tracked file literally named `.mjs`; two tracked files whose names are a mangled Windows path (`UsersmikeAppDataLocalTempclaudec--Code-…devbar-says-check.png` and `…paging_rows.json`); tracked `panel-band.png`, `panel-dark.png`, `bunnystream.html`, `check.mjs`, `dev.mjs`. Ignored strays: `down-400.png`, `kill-400.png`, twelve `lay-*.png`, folders `--help/`, `Temp/`, `scratch/`, `scratchpad/`, `test-layout-out/`, `layout-check-out/` (11 MB), `.playwright-mcp/`, `.scratch/`. Also `public/framework/core/Item/.transport-test-1132/` (an untracked test leftover).
**Size:** about 12 MB.
**Why it matters:** the owner's rule (2026-10-13) is a clean `git status`; a root full of loose files hides real ones. Each is also an unindexed file.
**Proposed action:** `git mv` the tracked ones under `moved-aside/` with a manifest; delete the ignored shots; make the test remove `.transport-test-*`. Check `bunnystream.html`, `check.mjs`, `dev.mjs` are not imported first.
**Revertible:** tracked ones yes; ignored ones no (all small).

add.title: 🧹 J4: Servex's own moved-aside and backup folders
add.text:
**What:** `backup/prompts.bloated-2026-09-23.jsonl` (394 MB, named for what it is, 47 days old); `moved-aside/` has 12 timestamped folders, six of them the same `ux-screens/cache.jsonl` (2.9 MB) moved on 2026-11-01 and 11-07; 105 `restart-*.log` files in the Servex home; `salvage/` 20 MB.
**Where:** `%LOCALAPPDATA%/lew42/servex/`.
**Size:** about 460 MB.
**Why it matters:** a repeated move-aside means something recreates the same file each time. Fix the cause, not only the copies.
**Proposed action:** zip the bloated prompts file; keep the newest `moved-aside` copy per path; keep 10 restart logs; find what re-creates `ux-screens/cache.jsonl`.
**Revertible:** yes if zipped.

add.title: ♊ D1: two Session classes with one name
add.text:
**What:** `core/Session/Session.js` (258 lines, the data class) and `ext/Session/Session.js` (317 lines, the voice-session UI with its own `page.js`, `failures.jsonl`, `tasks/`).
**Why it matters:** `import { Session }` from the wrong path compiles and silently gives the other class (a known trap in `framework/readme.md`).
**Proposed action:** rename the ext one to what it does (for example `VoiceSession.js`) and keep a one-line shim at the old path. Same for `core/Session/Chat/Chat.js` (35 lines) against `ext/Chat/Chat.js` (984 lines, the real one).
**Revertible:** yes (git).

add.title: ♊ D2: lookalikes where both copies hold real code
add.text:
**What:** (a) `ai/cards/Outline.js` (140 lines) and `Compose.js` (67) against `ext/Refine/Outline.js` (50) and `stages/Compose.js` (30): two refiner implementations. (b) `audio/Transcriber/Whisper.js` (222) against `audio/Whisper/Whisper.js` (77). (c) `core/Page/Log.js` (16) against `ai/rail/Log.js` (131). (d) `core/App/App.js` and `core/Router/Router.js` against `core/new/1/App.js` and `Router.js` (the old copies, already a known import trap). (e) your known pair `core/Task/Question.js` (37) vs `ux/Content/Question/Question.js` (63), and `core/Task/Prompt.js` (189) vs `core/Session/Chat/Prompt.js` (100).
**Why it matters:** two ways to do one job; a fix lands in only one.
**Proposed action:** a Sonnet pass per pair to decide which is live (by import count), then fold the other into it. (a) is already covered by the one-refiner plan. (d): move `core/new` aside.
**Revertible:** yes.

add.title: ♊ D3: shim files that are fine, and the rest of the tab systems
add.text:
**What:** these are thin re-exports kept so old imports work, not duplicates: `ai/systems/System.js`, `Systems.js`, `NavigationSystem.js`, `ReadmeSystem.js` (2 lines each, point to `ext/System/`); `ux/Dictate/WhisperLog.js` (2 lines); `ext/Omnibox` (a pointer readme; the box is `core/Search/Omnibox.js`). `core/Page/ext/Inbox/Timeline.js` and `ext/Timeline/Timeline.js` differ (89 and 127 lines): a pair to check.
**Why it matters:** shims hide real duplicates in counts; they should carry a removal date.
**Proposed action:** grep for remaining importers of each shim; delete a shim once it has none. Leave the 10 tab systems under `/live/tabs/` to their own audit.
**Revertible:** yes.

add.title: 📚 U1: 707 of 2,049 doc files are named in no readme
add.text:
**What:** a script read every `readme.md` under `public/framework` (skipping `ai/sessions`, `research`, `audit`) and checked each other `.md` filename against them. 707 are not named anywhere. Worst: `ext/DesignTool` 52, `ext/Panel` 49, `core/Page` 46 (outside the folders the readme-maps work covered), `ai/AITask` 42, `core/View` 42, `ai/doc` 29, `ext/Refine` 24, `core/App` 21, `ext/Collab` 21, `core/new` 18, `ext/Draggable` 18, `core/Shell` 17.
**Why it matters:** law 11 says a file no readme links to is lost.
**Proposed action:** per module, a Haiku pass lists its unindexed docs; the module's mastermind adds one line each or retires the doc. Do `ext/DesignTool`, `ext/Panel`, `core/View`, `ai/AITask` first (about 185 files).
**Revertible:** yes.

add.title: 📚 U2: 142 folders with 3 or more entries have no readme; 127 old tasks/ folders
add.text:
**What:** the same scan found 142 such folders. Three groups: (1) 127 per-module `tasks/` folders holding 5,126 files, the old task layout (since 2026-10-26 a task lives in its session); (2) data folders like `catalog/thumbs` (229 files), `audit/modules` (30), `ext/Figma/tasks` (96); (3) real modules missing a readme: `ext/ai`, `ext/Chat/ai`, `ext/drawer/{ai,rail,tabs,walkthrough}`, `ext/Figma/{palette,tokens,guide,autolayout,colors,scripts}`, `ext/Refine/{queue,runs,fixture}`, `ext/AITask/tree`, `dev/DevShell/shots`, `code/performance/bench`. Also `ReadmeOrphans` reports `core/Role` named by no parent readme.
**Proposed action:** (1) a scripted move of old `tasks/` folders into one `archive/tasks/` with a manifest, a single readme line; (2) one-line readmes for data folders ("generated, do not edit"); (3) a real readme for group three, most of all `ext/drawer` and `ext/Figma`; (4) add `core/Role` to `core/readme.md`.
**Revertible:** yes (scripted move with a manifest).

**How this was done:** one node script walked the repo and Servex's home (73,059 + 15,839 files, 2.3 s), then 3 more small scripts for pngs, readme coverage and same-name classes. No agents were spawned, so the audit cost no model tokens beyond this session. Usage was at 43% of pace when it started. Not measured: sizes of the other folders in `C:/Code/lew42` (`moved-aside`, `scratchpad`, `scratch_check`, `scratch-servex-crash`, `worktree-archive`, `wt-refine-haiku-live`) and the 10 `/live/tabs/` systems. The scripts are in the session scratchpad, not the repo.

add.title: 🧹 J5: 2.3 GB more of leftovers beside the repo
add.text:
**What:** `C:/Code/lew42/moved-aside` 1,075 MB, `wt-refine-haiku-live` 832 MB (looks like an old worktree; Servex still has `wt-refine-haiku-live` logs), `worktree-archive` 374 MB, plus tiny `scratchpad`, `scratch_check`, `scratch-servex-crash` (7 MB together) and a stray `probe-tmp.mjs`.
**Why it matters:** these were not in the first tally; with J1 the folders around the repo hold about 12.6 GB.
**Proposed action:** for each, check nothing unmerged is inside (`git -C <dir> status`), then zip or delete the oldest first. Move-asides are meant as a safety net, so give them an expiry (for example 30 days) written in their readme.
**Revertible:** yes if zipped; NO if deleted.
Git hygiene: why the work tree is dirty

add.title: 🧼 Recommendation: widen the sweeper, ignore two files, decide the data repo later
add.text:
The tree is dirty because the log sweeper (`/Servex/LogSweeper.js`, commits records every 30 min, 312 sweeps this week) skips 8 paths and runs only twice an hour. Add those paths to its list, ignore two rebuildable files, and sweep every 10 min. Nothing here needs a second repo yet.

**Measured 2026-11-09:** 58 dirty paths (39 modified, 19 untracked); 1,091 commits in 7 days, 312 of them sweeps. Existing notes this builds on: [commit-rule](/framework/ai/sessions/doc/commit-rule.md) (records committed, caches ignored), [repo-size](/framework/ai/doc/repo-size.md), [git flow](/framework/doc/git.md).
**Revertible:** every proposal is a `.gitignore` or sweeper-list edit; yes.

add.title: 🧪 core/Test/results.jsonl: 7 MB, 8,507 new lines, never swept
add.text:
**Writer:** `core/Test/TestRunner.mjs` appends one line per test run (also `merge-base` runs). **Note:** the file is `results.jsonl`, not `.json`.
**Size/growth:** 7.1 MB, 45,718 lines since 2026-10-23. 11-07 alone added 7,427 lines (a test storm); other days 100 to 1,600.
**Rebuildable:** no (it is run history), but only the latest result per test is shown.
**Why dirty:** it is in no sweeper list, so it only changes when a person commits it.
**Proposal: rotate into dated files** (`results/2026-11-09.jsonl`), keep the last 7 days, gitignore the rest. Check first what `TestResults.js` reads.

add.title: 📁 files.jsonl: leave committed, it is already swept
add.text:
**Writer:** the dev server's folder listing, plus `Server/page-files-backfill.mjs`. **Where:** `public/files.jsonl` (4 KB, 24 commits in 7 days) and one new untracked `live/calibration/files.jsonl` (46 bytes).
**Rebuildable:** yes, but [repo-size](/framework/ai/doc/repo-size.md) says the static site reads them and there is no build step, so ignoring would break production.
**Proposal: keep as is.** The sweeper already matches it; the untracked one is only a new folder waiting for the next sweep.

add.title: 📬 inbox.jsonl, usage.jsonl, live pages: records, already swept
add.text:
**inbox.jsonl** (`ai/`, 108 KB, 278 lines): the owner-note and inbox record. **usage.jsonl** (506 KB, 4,042 lines since 2026-08-14, about 100 lines a day): Servex's usage history, which the sweeper list marks "owner keeps it". **live pages** (`public/live/*/page.jsonl`, 2 to 16 KB): written by the page tools.
**Rebuildable:** no.
**Why dirty:** they change between sweeps, so they are dirty for up to 30 min. That is the only cause.
**Proposal:** keep committed. For usage.jsonl, rotate monthly (`usage/2026-11.jsonl`): it is touched by 321 of this week's 1,091 commits, so history stays readable and the file stops growing.

add.title: 🧾 unmerged.json: a snapshot, so ignore it
add.text:
**Writer:** `Server/unmerged.mjs` rewrites the whole 25 KB file on each run (2 commits in 7 days).
**Rebuildable:** yes, one command.
**Proposal: gitignore** it, as `usage.json` and `tasks.json` already are. Revertible.

add.title: 📒 task-moves, session-links, worktree-removals, core/Page/task.jsonl: add to the sweeper
add.text:
**Writers:** `Server/TaskMove.mjs`, `SessionRecord.mjs`, `worktree-leftovers.mjs`; the last is a task record. **Where:** `ai/sessions/*.jsonl` (task-moves 976 KB / 3,744 lines, session-links 212 KB, worktree-removals 69 KB) and `core/Page/task.jsonl` (11 KB).
**Rebuildable:** no; they are the move manifests that [agents.md](/framework/ai/agents.md) requires.
**Why dirty:** no sweeper pattern matches them, so they sit modified for days.
**Proposal:** add two patterns, `ai/sessions/*.jsonl` ledgers and any `<module>/task.jsonl`, to `LogSweeper.ALLOW`.

add.title: 🚩 clarity/flags.jsonl is not old: written today
add.text:
**Writer:** `Server/clarity.mjs`; the clarity agent is woken when a task lands. The last line was written 2026-11-09 23:50 UTC.
**Size/growth:** 523 KB, 2,419 lines since 2026-09-25 (about 53 a day), changed in 35 commits this week.
**Rebuildable:** no.
**Proposal:** keep, already swept. If the clarity pipeline is retired later, retire the file with it. To shrink commits, rotate monthly like usage.

add.title: 🗂 Session folder files: 39 modified, 19 untracked
add.text:
**What:** `session.jsonl` (17), `inbox.jsonl` (6), review folders and files, `requirements.md`, `plan.md`, mostly under `ai/sessions/2026/11/06` to `11/09`.
**Writer:** Servex and the agents. The `.jsonl` records are swept. The `.md` files are blocked on purpose (`LogSweeper.DENY`): they are agent-written documents, and the agent should commit them itself. Nobody does, so they sit untracked.
**Proposal:** a task closing (`close_task`) commits its own folder by exact path. That removes the untracked `review/` folders and `.md` files at the source.

add.title: 🔀 Two repos for session data: what it buys and costs
add.text:
**You said:** "two repos where one tracks the session data", and you do not want to decide now. So this is a comparison.
**Option A, nested repo:** `ai/sessions/` becomes its own git repo, ignored by the main one. The code tree is clean and the paths do not change. It costs: `git grep` over the session logs ([indexing-past-work](/framework/ai/indexing-past-work.md)) no longer reaches it from the main repo, and a second repo to back up to GitHub.
**Option B, one repo, wider sweeper (the recommendation above):** costs only 10 lines of config. The history stays noisy: 312 sweep commits a week, but they are all named "servex: log sweep" and easy to filter.
**Later signal:** switch to A if `.git` (1.3 GB today) keeps growing or the sweep commits drown real ones. Production already skips the sessions folder (`public/.assetsignore`), so nothing on the live site depends on them being in this repo.
